verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents live, around-the-clock customer support for Wise Business account holders. The Cases API (wise-docs-17) is a programmatic channel for opening support queries, an adjacent developer feature rather than live support. Community reports describe slow, asynchronous handling, such as a 30-day response window on an urgent account-detail change (wise-comm-5) and a fully blocked business account (wise-comm-6), with no sign of immediate live help.
